column1: # Part 2 clause 6.3.3.1.4's presentation names, whole or in chunks, as src/ac4dec/ERRATA.md
# ("A presentation name in chunks") reads them. Each case: frames' presentation_name bytes in hex,
# space-separated, "-" for a frame whose presentation substream sends no name; then the name
# after the last frame, UTF-8, empty for none. tests/ac4dec/test_ac4dec_api.cpp decodes them
# through the decoder, tools/checks/test_ac4_presentation_names.py through the Python reference.
